title: Fictional draft follow-up assessment of API-100-A3 for Summit Analytics CAP-140

assessor.name: Morgan Ellis
assessor.independence_statement: This fictional assessor is presented only to illustrate a bounded follow-up record and has no operational ownership of the fictional CAP-140 gateway.

assessment_scope.subject: Fictional Summit Analytics workforce-research assistant CAP-140
assessment_scope.boundary: One follow-up API-100-A3 emergency-restriction exercise on the fictional CAP-140 staging gateway after completion of the owner action linked to ASR-ENG3-API100 and FND-ENG3-API100-EMERGENCY.
exclusions: Production restriction and recovery behavior, production bypass paths, repeated operation over time, and API-100-A1 and API-100-A2 were not reassessed.
assessment_scope.population: The fictional CAP-140 staging gateway emergency model-restriction path.
assessment_scope.sample: One controlled staging restriction exercise using the approved fictional test model alias; this is not a statistical sample.

methods.procedure: API-100-A3 - Test: Exercise emergency provider or model restriction.
methods.object: Fictional CAP-140 staging gateway and restriction harness, evidence EVD-ENG4-API100-RESTRICTION.
methods.expected_result: The emergency restriction blocks new requests to the selected model alias, records the action, and returns the gateway to the approved restricted state.
methods.actual_work: Executed one controlled staging exercise. The selected alias was blocked, the event was logged, and a subsequent request remained blocked. No production request or recovery process was exercised.

determination_rationale: The follow-up Test supports that the emergency-restriction function operated in one staging exercise and resolves the specific condition associated with original finding FND-ENG3-API100-EMERGENCY for this bounded test. API-100-A1, API-100-A2, production operation, and sustained operating effectiveness were not reassessed, so the result does not determine API-100 satisfied.

findings.statement: This follow-up finding records verification of the emergency-restriction condition first documented in FND-ENG3-API100-EMERGENCY; it is a distinct finding because ESAF findings are nested within one assessment result.

disposition.action: The fictional owner added a staging exercise harness and completed one emergency-restriction exercise; the assessor verified the limited result under API-100-A3.
disposition.rationale: The follow-up evidence supports resolution of the specific emergency-restriction exercise gap described by original finding FND-ENG3-API100-EMERGENCY within the staging sample. The original result remains unchanged, and broader control effectiveness is not established.

limitations: This is a fictional follow-up result and remains Draft.
The follow-up does not revise the original ASR-ENG3-API100 result or reassess its original period.
One staging exercise does not establish production operation, sustained operating effectiveness, capability-wide effectiveness, certification, compliance, equivalence, endorsement, or assurance.

change_history.author: Morgan Ellis
change_history.description: Recorded one bounded API-100-A3 staging follow-up linked to original finding FND-ENG3-API100-EMERGENCY; the original assessment result remains unchanged.

example_notice: Fictional non-authoritative example; no organization, ESAF control, profile, or external framework has been assessed.
